description: Search tours, activities, and experiences for a destination and get BreckenWander's all-in "from" price (USD). Returns a link that opens that specific experience to book on breckenwander.com. Read-only: does not book or take payment. Combine with flights and hotels into one trip using build_trip.

adults.description: Number of adults (context only; final price is set at booking).

date_from.description: Optional preferred date (YYYY-MM-DD); the exact date is chosen on breckenwander.com.

date_to.description: Optional end of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

destination.description: City or place name, e.g. "Rome" or "Cancun".

name: search_experiences
title: Search experiences & activities on BreckenWander
